entities.name: Gabriela Laperrière de Coni
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Gabriela Laperrière de Coni was an Argentine journalist, socialist, and public health activist. She founded the Feminist Socialist Center of the Argentine Socialist Party, and served on the executive committee of the party, the first woman to do so. She was a pioneering intellectual who devoted her energy to the cause of feminist issues related to working women in Argentina.
